inputs.text: Phoenix’s city council voted Wednesday night to keep ICE and other law enforcement agencies from using city property. That’s not a safeguard for ordinary families; it’s a political choice that puts ideology ahead of cooperation with authorities and public safety. When officials make it harder for law enforcement to do its job, they weaken the rule of law and risk deepening distrust in the institutions meant to protect the community.
